production_change: Capture WebSocketAcceptAlt in the existing declaration pattern and pass that captured value instead of casting. Preserve the explanatory object accept local, aliases, branches, async flow and every other production statement.
compatibility: All original and changed Owin tests and every new individual row pass without skips.
Actual OwinEnvironment feature-map producer supplies the alternate delegate; actual UseOwin default registration is exercised.
Missing/null/wrong/standard delegate guards, environment identity, next await and exception identity are preserved.
Actual accept/callback execution, status guards, options/native-context identity, cancellation token and subprotocol are preserved.
Real ManagedWebSocket binary frames are decoded by a real peer and normal cleanup aborts the owned server socket.
No public signature, default, convention, cache, dependency or unrelated production change.

measurement.policy: Identical harness/PDB/runtime/configuration and immutable A/B outputs; only the owning Owin DLL may differ. Measure complete adapted requests, actual feature-map producers, default UseOwin and real frames/lifetime, not an extracted cast.
measurement.disposition_policy: Publish no-gain instead of a style-only PR when no material compatible optimization is supported. Preserve every small gain, non-win and allocation result.

excluded: Hosted HTTP upgrade or network negotiation
